description: Phase 1 (บอง 2026-07-27): มุน is adding 2s infinite CSS-loop animations to the /v2 home (Zone 4/5/6). Any lens that diffs TWO frames reads a huge pixel diff for a reason unrelated to the bug it hunts = a guaranteed false-red (ตู๋). Fix: freezeAnimations(page) renders the page in its reduced-motion STATIC state before the first pixel-compared shot. Chose reducedMotion reduce (Playwright emulateMedia) over animation-play-state:paused (freezes at the CURRENT frame, so a slow-vs-fast load pauses at a different loop phase = a timing-dependent flaky; บอง retracted his own first instruction) and over animation:none / WAAPI currentTime=0 as the PRIMARY (both snap an element to base/0%, so an entrance like z3-pop whose 0% is opacity:0 would render INVISIBLE — measured, not guessed). reducedMotion fires the page OWN prefers-reduced-motion guards so elements land at มุน intended static (opacity:1; transform:none) with entrances visible; a WAAPI currentTime=0 pin is kept as a belt for any animation lacking a reduced-motion guard. Wired into pixel-anchor.ts, the ONLY frame-vs-frame lens. Sweep of all 8 harness screenshot calls: pixel-anchor.ts (frameA/frameB) = FROZEN; run-bg-continuity.ts (single-frame seam sampled on the static LEFT BG margin), run-verdict-color.ts (single-frame Zone-1 ring hue), capture.ts (verdict from measurements, shot is human evidence), capture-route.ts (human-review PNGs) = EXEMPT — single-frame or human-view, and animation cannot false-red a single coherent frame; empirically all three lenses still PASS on the now-animated page. Proof (run-freeze-proof.ts, live /v2/home-preview): (A) determinism — the same page frozen at 3 different loop-phase offsets (0/660/1320ms) diffs 0/0/0 (บอง: prove with 3 DIFFERENT timings, not 2 back-to-back); (B) non-vacuous — 11 animations live before the freeze, 0 after. FOUND-NOT-FIXED (UI, owner=มุน, queued): z3-rock-l (base rotate(7deg)) and z3-rock-r (base scaleX(-1) rotate(8.55deg)) hold their base transform ONLY in the @keyframe while the reduced-motion guard forces transform:none, so under any remove-animation freeze they snap to identity and lose the tilt/flip. This is also a real accessibility bug (a reduce-motion user sees the right rock un-flipped, facing the wrong way) — reported for มุน to move the base onto the element/class and stop forcing transform:none. gate_layer=harness/tooling + rendered-pixel.
